title: Fix drift repair clobbering foreign scalar ancestors (VC-201-064)
goal: managed_drift::reconcile repairs an owned leaf beneath a foreign non-object ancestor by replacing that ancestor with an object: desired {a:{b:1}} vs observed {a:'foreign-scalar'} (or an array) with owned={a.b} yields repaired {a:{b:1}} — the external value at a is destroyed, violating 'never overwrites foreign state' (vc_201_064_mastery_owned_leaf_under_foreign_scalar/array_clobbers_it). drift() also reports no item for the foreign leaf at 'a', so the operator never sees what repair would destroy. Fix: set_leaf must refuse to convert a non-object observed node, and drift should surface the blocked repair as a conflict.
